stories.title: How AI is changing the nature of cyberattacks
stories.why: AI may be helping cyberattackers increase the speed and scale of their operations, but it is not yet changing their core objectives or the techniques they employ as part of their attack chains.

stories.title: The firewall becomes the foothold: Attackers turn Check Point gateways against customers
stories.why: A firewall is intended to be a boundary attackers can’t cross.

stories.title: AI found Linux kernel bugs that remained undetected for decades
stories.why: A Microsoft research project combining AI agents with human security researchers uncovered 59 Linux kernel vulnerabilities, including bugs that had survived in production code for more than 20 years.

stories.title: November 2026 Patch Tuesday: 63 Critical Microsoft fixes, plus an Outlook zero day that allows theft of hashed credentials
stories.why: A currently exploited zero-day vulnerability that can let attackers steal hashed Outlook NTLM credentials is among the 1,094 holes Microsoft fixed in its November Patch Tuesday releases.

stories.title: Cursor Says Stolen Fireworks AI Key Led to Trojanized Claude Code Extension Incident
stories.why: The compromise of Anthropic's official Claude Code extension on Cursor's extension marketplace was the result of the theft of an access key that was exposed in the wake of a breach targeting Fireworks AI.

stories.title: FBI Says North Korean Hackers Stole Over $400 Million in Crypto Using Deepfake Video Calls
How one AI agent exposed five critical enterprise security gaps
stories.why: An AI agent built to automate invoice processing could be manipulated into changing vendor bank details through a malicious email, without triggering traditional security alerts.

stories.title: Cursor confirms security breach led to malicious Claude Code extension
stories.why: Cursor confirmed it suffered a security breach that let hackers distribute a malicious Claude Code extension through its marketplace after stealing credentials from AI infrastructure provider Fireworks AI.

stories.title: Your pinned MCP server may not be as pinned as you think
stories.why: An MCP server configured to run one fixed release on an administrator’s workstation ran with 15 different sets of dependencies over five weeks, with its configuration untouched.

stories.title: Japan Pushes Emergency Funding for Cybersecurity as AI-Assisted Breaches Rise
stories.why: The package adds public-private cyber responders, an AI-focused team run by the economic ministry, and more leeway to use the government's new active cyber-defense powers.
